Form OR-40-V Instructions
Oregon Individual Income Tax Payment Voucher Instructions
Purpose
Use Form OR-40-V to mail a payment to the department
without your Oregon individual income tax return. See
your return instructions, Publication OR-40-EXT, or Publi-
cation OR-ESTIMATE for more information.
Payment options
Online
You can make payments anytime at www.oregon.gov/dor.
Don’t use Form OR-40-V when paying online.
By mail
Make your check, money order, or cashier’s check payable
to the Oregon Department of Revenue. Don’t mail cash.
Write the tax year, “Form OR-40-V,” your daytime phone,
and the last four digits of your Social Security number
(SSN) or individual taxpayer identification number (ITIN)
on the payment.
Mailed with your tax return: If you’re mailing a payment
with your tax return, send the payment in the same enve-
lope with the return and don’t use a voucher. See your tax
return for the mailing address.
Mailed without your tax return: If you’re mailing a pay-
ment without your tax return, use this voucher. Mail the
payment and voucher to:
Oregon Department of Revenue
PO Box 14950
Salem OR 97309-0950
Form OR-40-V instructions
Tax year. Enter the month, day, and year for the beginning
and end date of the tax year for this payment. For most fil-
ers this will be January 1 through December 31 of the tax
year. Example: For tax year 2025, enter:
Begins: 01/01/2025. Ends: 12/31/2025.
Quarter. This box is for your records only. You can use this
box to note the quarter if you’re making estimated tax pay-
ments. For calendar year 2026, the due dates for estimated
tax payments are:
• Quarter 1: April 15, 2026.
• Quarter 2: June 15, 2026.
• Quarter 3: September 15, 2026.
• Quarter 4: January 15, 2027.
Taxpayer information. Completely fill out the information
on the form. If your address has changed since the last time
you filed a return, complete a Change of Address/Name form
and mail it to us. Your address will not be updated using
information on Form OR-40-V.
Payment type. Check the appropriate box.
Having trouble viewing this form? If you are viewing the
voucher form electronically and you see a solid box instead
of letters or numbers, adjust the view size to 100 percent
and press the tab key to move through the fields.
Visit www.oregon.gov/dor/forms to print more vouchers.
Do you have questions or need help?
www.oregon.gov/dor
503-378-4988 or 800-356-4222
questions.dor@dor.oregon.gov
Contact us for ADA accommodations or assistance in other
languages.
